B.text: If each printed percentage immediately above a program bar is the authoritative reported reduction share for that program, the largest printed percentage identifies the largest contribution; the task directs that program to accelerated review.
B.conditions: Applies if the percentage annotations are authoritative despite their disagreement with bar heights.

B.text: If bar height on the vertical scale encodes the reported reduction share for each program, the tallest bar identifies the largest contribution; the task directs that program to accelerated review.
